headline: Eleven degrees under still-thick cloud.
body: Temperature has risen to eleven degrees. A light south-west breeze continues at five kilometres an hour; pressure holds at one thousand twenty-nine and remains steady. High cloud still covers most of the sky nearly two hours after sunrise, and the paving stays dry.
